senses.gloss:
ITA-8.3.42 śuktam शुक्तम्
Vinegar
A kind of sour liquid prepared from roots and fruits by first steeping them in oil and salt, then drying them before placing them in water to undergo acetous fermentation.

ITA-5.66.52 śuktiḥ शुक्तिः
Xerosis
A disorder characterized by blackish fleshlike dots; dots resembling muscle tissue; dots having the lustre of a pearl shell; blackish spots; yellowish spots; resembling a dirty mirror; burning sensation; pain; altered bowels/loose stools; thirst; fever.

ITA-7.1.4.8 śuktiḥ शुक्तिः
Measure of weight approximately equal to 24 g
Measure of weight equal to 2 karsha.

ITA-7.2.8.4 śuktiḥ शुक्तिः
Pearl oyster
Calcium carbonate (CaCO3). Duly processed shukti is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-5.3.25 śukrakṣayaḥ शुक्रक्षयः
Diminution of semen
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: weakness or loss of physical strength; dryness of mouth; pallor/pale colour of body parts; exhaustion/tiredness of body and mind; inability to perform sexual act/impotence; inability to ejaculate semen/ suppression of semen; penile pain; scrotal pain/severe scrotal pain; inability to perform sexual act; delayed ejaculation; ejaculation of semen along with blood; black-outs; pricking type of scrotal pain; smoky sensation in penis.

ITA-5.61.21 śukragatamasūrikā शुक्रगतमसूरिका
Lentil-shaped pox disease localized in semen
Lentil-shaped eruptive disorder is characterized by the suppurating appearance of the eruptions); unctuous apprearance of eruptions; minute eruptions; extremely painful; sensation of being covered with a wet cloth; distress/ discontent/restlessness; unconsciousness/confusion; burning sensation; associated with insanity; causing death.

ITA-5.2.1.21 śukragatavātaḥ शुक्रगतवातः
Aggravation of vata in seminal tissue
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: delayed labour/postterm delivery, miscarriage/ abortion/preterm delivery; delayed ejaculation; premature ejaculation; congenital anomalies in offspring; inability to ejaculate.

ITA-9.9.49 śukragatavātaḥ शुक्रगतवातः
Channels of male seed affected by vāta
A pathological condition in which vitiated vata enters the semen enriching channels, leading to various abnormal conditions.

ITA-6.2.6.23 śukraharaḥ, śukraghnam शुक्रहरः, शुक्रघ्नम्
Substance that is harmful for semen production

ITA-6.2.6.20 śukrajananam शुक्रजननम्
Semen-producing

ITA-9.9.6 śukrajananam शुक्रजननम्
Treatment promoting semen production
Therapy or medicines with semen-forming properties (spermatogenesis).

ITA-9.9.50 śukrajananam शुक्रजननम्
Semen-producing measure
A therapeutic measure for spermatogenesis.

ITA-5.39.9 śukrajanyamūtrakṛcchram शुक्रजन्यमूत्रकृच्छ्रम्
Difficulty in urination due to vitiated semen
A disorder characterized by difficulty in passing urine; stiffness of scrotum; penile pain; pain in bladder region.

ITA-3.12.8 śukradharākalā शुक्रधराकला
Sukra-bearing membrane

ITA-2.2.18 śukradhātuḥ शुक्रधातुः
Reproductive fluids; semen
The seventh of the seven fundamental structural components. It is responsible for reproductive function, and is generally equated with reproductive cells (semen, ovum). It occurs in two forms: the first which pervades the entire body and the second which fertilizes the ovum.

ITA-5.6.34 śukradhātugatajvaraḥ शुक्रधातुगतज्वरः
Fever due to vitiated seminal tissue
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: spermatorrhoea; death; death; persistent penile priapism; black-outs; impacts/damage to marmasthāna.

ITA-2.6.18 śukradhātvagniḥ शुक्रधात्वग्निः
Metabolic factors located in semen
The transformative factor which converts bone marrow to reproductive fluids and semen .

ITA-9.9.51 śukraprasādanam शुक्रप्रसादनम्
Semen-improving therapy
Therapy or medicines which normalize spermatogenesis and produce normal and healthy sperm.

ITA-5.41.8 śukramehaḥ शुक्रमेहः
Polyuria disorder with semen-mixed urine
A disorder characterized by urine resembling semen; semenmixed urination; frequent micturition.

ITA-6.2.6.21 śukralaḥ शुक्रलः
Promoting optimum semen quantity
The therapeutic action of a drug which increases semen.

ITA-9.9.52 śukralaḥ शुक्रलः
Semen-increasing therapy
Therapy or medicines to increase the semen.

ITA-2.5.17 śukravahasrotaḥ शुक्रवहस्रोतः
Channel carrying structural components of reproduction
The pathway for structural components of reproduction. Entities related to this channel are the testicles and penis.

ITA-5.5.11 shukravahasrotoduṣṭiḥ शुक्रवहस्रोतोदुष्टिः
Vitiation of channels carrying semen
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: impotency, sterility, abortion and congenital deformities.

ITA-5.73.32 śukravahasrotoviddha शुक्रवहस्रोतोविद्ध
Injury to the channels of the genital system
A disorder characterized by inability to perform the sexual act/ impotence; delayed ejaculation; blood-tinged semen.

ITA-9.9.46 śukravikṛtiḥ शुक्रविकृतिः
Seminal abnormalities
Abnormal or pathological state of semen or sperm.

ITA-9.9.4 śukravivardhanam शुक्रविवर्धनम्
Treatment increasing amount of semen
Therapy or medicines able to increase the amount of semen.

ITA-5.3.26 śukravṛddhiḥ शुक्रवृद्धिः
Morbid increase of semen
A disorder characterized by seminal calculi/crystals; excessive ejaculation of semen; excessive desire for intercourse with women.

ITA-5.75.19 śukravegarodhaḥ शुक्रवेगरोधः
Disorder due to withholding of ejaculation
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: penile pain; scrotal pain; generalized body aches; precordial pain/cardiac pain; obstruction to passage of urine/retention/oliguria; bladder swelling; anal swelling; scrotal swelling; pain in bladder; pain in anus; seminal calculi/ crystals; seminal discharge; swelling of genitals; fever; breaking type of pain in body; scrotal enlargement; impotence.

ITA-5.3.24 śukravaiṣamyam शुक्रवैषम्यम्
Disproportion of semen
Changes in the normal quantity and quality of seminal tissue.

ITA-6.2.6.22 śukraśodhanam शुक्रशोधनम्
Substances that cleanse or purify semen
A qualitative improvement of semen.

ITA-9.9.7 śukraśodhanam शुक्रशोधनम्
Treatment improving quality of semen
Therapy or medicines with semen-purifying properties.

ITA-9.9.53 śukraśodhanam शुक्रशोधनम्
Semen-purifying therapy
Therapy or medicines to purify the semen.

ITA-9.9.54 śukrasaṁvāhakaḥ शुक्रसंवाहकः
Ejaculation-promoting therapy
Therapy or medicines to boost ejaculation.

ITA-2.8.1.8 śukra-sāraḥ शुक्रसारः
Person with predominance or essence of semen
Characterized by features such as, gentleness; milky-looking eyes; enthusiasm; smooth and pleasant voice; large buttocks; strength; happiness; prosperity; health; wealth and many progeny.

ITA-9.9.47 śukrastambhanimittajaklaibyam शुक्रस्तम्भनिमित्तजक्लैब्यम्
Obstruction to semen flow or formation
Decreased production of sperm in semen owing either to an obstructed ejaculatory tract or decreased motility.

ITA-9.9.3 śukrasrutikaram शुक्रस्रुतिकरम्
Treatment stimulating ejaculation
Therapy or medicines promoting the ejaculation of semen.

ITA-9.9.55 śukrāpyāyanam शुक्राप्यायनम्
Maintaining and promoting normal semen production
Therapeutic measures which maintain the normal production of sperm and semen.

ITA-5.35.5 śukrābhighātaja-udāvartaḥ शुक्राभिघातज-उदावर्तः
Disorders of reversed or altered visceral movement due to suppression of ejaculation
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: pain in bladder; anal pain; scrotal pain; swelling in bladder; anal swelling; scrotal oedema; urinary retention; seminal calculi/crystals; premature ejaculation.

ITA-5.40.6 śukrāśmarī शुक्राश्मरी
Urinary calculus due to crystallization of semen
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: dysuria; pain in urinary bladder or basti; swelling of scrotum; disappearing with passage of semen.

ITA-9.9.56 śukrotpādakaḥ शुक्रोत्पादकः
Spermatogenic measure
A therapeutic action that generates semen and androgens.

ITA-9.9.57 śukropacayaḥ शुक्रोपचयः
Semen qualityincreasing measure
Therapy or medicines with spermatogenesis-increasing potency.

ITA-3.2.1.12 śukla-kṛṣṇa-sandhiḥ शुक्लकृष्णसन्धिः
Sclerocorneal junction

ITA-3.2.1.29 śuklamaṇḍalam, śvetamaṇḍalam शुक्लमण्डलम्, श्वेतमण्डलम्
Sclera

ITA-5.41.7 śuklamehaḥ शुक्लमेहः
Polyuria disorder with excessive whitish urine
A disorder characterized by elimination of floury whitish urine; increased urinary frequency.

ITA-7.2.8.1 śuklavargaḥ, sudhāvargaḥ शुक्लवर्गः, सुधावर्गः
Group of whitecoloured substances
A group of whitish substances of mineral, plant and animal origin which contain natural calcium.

ITA-5.66.48 śuklārma शुक्लार्म
Pinguecula
A disorder characterized by a soft muscular growth; whitish muscular growth; even muscular growth; gradual growth of tissue.

ITA-8.2.2 śūkadhānyavargaḥ शूकधान्यवर्गः
Group of grains from grass seeds with awn
The group of grains derived from grass seeds having awn and spikes.

ITA-5.58.1 śūkarogaḥ शूकरोगः
Complications of due to forced increase of penile size
A group of disorders developing due to a forced increase in the size of the penis using external measures.

ITA-5.76.30 sukumāra vamanasya vyapadaḥ सुकुमार वमनस्य व्यपदः
Condition caused by emetic therapy administered to sensitive person
A condition characterized by haemorrhage through upward and downward tracts.

ITA-5.76.56 sukumāra-virecanavyāpat सुकुमार-विरेचनव्यापत्
Condition caused by purgation therapy administered to people with fragile bodily constitution
A condition characterized by haemorrhage through the upward and downward tracts.

ITA-1.9.4.2.16 sūkṣmaḥ सूक्ष्मः
Minuteness, penetrating
The quality of a substance which is responsible for minuteness and consequent ability to pass through barriers.
